exposure: definition of 'most responsible provider' in Canadian National Discharge Abstract Database (DAD)
definition of 'most responsible provider' in chart data
outcome: discrepancy in 'most responsible provider' identification between data sources
cohort: The study compared chart data with administrative data related to the identification of 'most responsible provider' for caesarean outcomes.
finding: There was a 3% discrepancy between chart data and administrative data sources in identifying the 'most responsible provider' for caesarean outcomes, primarily attributable to transfers in care that occurred at birth.
